captions.detailed: An artisan-style bread maker featuring a wide, cream-colored rectangular body with rounded edges. It includes a hinged top lid with an integrated dark grey ingredient-dispenser flap on top, and a broad dark grey front panel containing a row of four light grey rectangular buttons next to a dark grey circular dial. The main lid is designed to swing upward from a rear hinge, the dispenser flap rotates on its own small hinge, and there is a rotating kneading spindle hidden inside the hollow baking chamber.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of an artisan-style bread maker appliance. The model must feature a hollowed main chamber with a hinged top lid, an integrated rotating ingredient-dispenser flap on the lid, and a front control panel hosting a series of four independent prismatic push buttons alongside a continuous-rotation timer dial.
captions.factory: The bread maker is constructed by first creating a main body using a rounded box, which is hollowed out with a boolean cut to form the baking chamber. The top lid is modeled as a rounded plate with a stepped profile, and a small rectangular recess is cut to house the dispenser flap. The front control panel uses a recessed rectangular cut on the body, filled with a dark panel plate, four small rectangular push buttons, and a cylindrical dial with fluted details. Inside the chamber, a small vertical spindle is added. Articulation joints are defined for the main lid (revolute), the dispenser flap (revolute), the four front buttons (prismatic), the front dial (continuous), and the internal kneading spindle (continuous).
